tool: Codex built-in image generation plus deterministic Pillow compositing
model: OpenAI built-in image model (model identifier not exposed)
style: Calm luminous paper-cut watercolour and gouache science storybook on cream paper; rain-blue, leaf-green and sunny-yellow; scientifically clear and non-frightening.

images.name: cover
images.prompt: Cast on their dry covered porch watching friendly rain over a green garden; recognisable standard funnel rain gauge in open grass; calm title space; exact cast identities and outfits; no text.

images.name: rain-gauge
images.prompt: Cutaway standard gauge in open grass: wide level collector funnel visibly feeding a much narrower transparent calibrated tube, blue water at a scale line, magnified path inset; only mm and ticks.

images.name: one-millimetre
images.prompt: One litre bottle beside a one-metre square covered by a thin one-millimetre water film, with side-view depth inset and rain boots for scale; only 1 m, 1 mm and 1 L labels.

images.name: ten-millimetres
images.prompt: Exactly ten one-litre bottles in two rows of five beside one 10 L bucket and one square metre with a shallow rain film; no people, animals or extra bottles; only 1 m and 10 L.

images.name: rain-intensity
images.prompt: Two equal garden panels with identical one-minute clocks: sparse light rain versus many close drops and more arrival in the same time; no totals, gauges, text or numbers.

images.name: accumulated
images.prompt: Same funnel gauge repeated morning, afternoon and evening with monotonically rising water at 5 mm, 15 mm and 30 mm; gentle rain and time pictograms.

images.name: short-vs-long
images.prompt: Two panels with identical final 30 mm gauge levels: 15-minute heavy shower and 6-hour gentle rain, clearly different intensity and duration but equal total.

images.name: news-numbers
images.prompt: Background plate: calm family living room with a raindrop icon on an unbranded television, opening onto a sunny garden with one empty bounded square-metre soil patch and no bottles or text. Sprite: exactly one upright unbranded clear one-litre watercolor bottle, front-facing, isolated, with no label or writing.
images.composition_method: reading-app/tools/build-rain-news-numbers.py extracts a transparent matte from the single generated sprite, then Pillow places that same sprite exactly 100 times as 10 rows by 10 columns with even per-row spacing on the separately generated background plate. It reuses the sprite once as the enlarged key and draws only the permitted 1 m and 1 L labels.
images.placement_assertion: PASS: exactly 100 placements (10 rows x 10 columns)

images.name: measuring-network
references: https://vemaps.com/thailand/th-01 (geographic outline reference only; attribution source not copied into art)
images.prompt: Preserve the accurate Thailand boundary proportions and long peninsula; green terrain and regionally distributed station dots; callout with Stevenson screen, funnel gauge, anemometer and observer; no labels or marks.

images.name: closing
images.prompt: Return to the exact cover porch and cast after rain: full gauge, soft rainbow, boots, shallow puddle and watering cans; preserve identities, outfits and safe calm mood; no text.
